{{Samename|character in ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''|Sam}} ''For the [[Pokémon Professor]], see [[Professor Oak]].'' ---- [[File:Samuel.png|thumb|250px|Samuel]] '''Samuel''' (Japanese: '''ソウタロウ''' ''Sōtarō''), also known as '''Sam''', is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is the assistant of {{an|Brandon|Pyramid King Brandon}}, and he also [[Battle judge|referees]] Brandon's matches. ==History== ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''=== Samuel debuted in ''[[AG178|Battling the Enemy Within!]]'', where he refereed the match of Brandon and {{Ash}}, the latter of whom was then possessed by the [[King of Pokélantis]]. At one point, the king used Samuel as a human shield by forcing {{AP|Sceptile}} to hide behind him as Brandon's {{DL|Brandon's legendary giants|Regirock}} was preparing to fire a {{m|Hyper Beam}} at it, but Brandon was able to stop Regirock in time. Samuel later accompanied Brandon, who was searching for a rare Pokémon at the [[Fennel Valley]] ruins. Ash and {{ashfr}} arrived at Fennel Valley, and Samuel refereed Ash's long-awaited rematch against Brandon in ''[[AG186|Overjoyed!]]''. After Ash's loss, Brandon continued to search the ruins. By ''[[AG188|Pinch Healing!]]'', Samuel confirmed that Brandon had finally located the rare Pokémon, allowing for Ash to have another chance at the Brave [[Symbol]]. In ''[[AG189|Gathering the Gang of Four!]]'' and ''[[AG190|Pace - The Final Frontier!]]'', Samuel refereed the battle between Brandon and Ash. Samuel almost awarded the victory to Brandon after {{AP|Pikachu}} was {{status|freeze|frozen}} by an {{m|Ice Beam}} from Brandon's {{DL|Brandon's legendary giants|Regice}}. However, Pikachu was able to break free and eventually win the match, earning Ash his final Symbol and a place in the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} [[Hall of Fame]]. ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''=== Samuel appeared in ''[[DP128|A Pyramiding Rage!]]'', where he was sent off with {{si|Maria}} to the [[Snowpoint Temple]]. In ''[[DP129|Pillars of Friendship!]]'', Samuel alerted Brandon and Ash's group to the arrival of mysterious people at Snowpoint Temple, who were later identified as [[J]] and her crew. While Brandon, Maria, and Ash's group deal with the trouble down at the Temple, Samuel was ordered to repair one of the [[Battle Pyramid]]'s broken motors. ==Character== Samuel is a reliable individual, often running errands on behalf of his boss {{an|Brandon|Pyramid King Brandon}}.
